en: Sorry, but I take the safety of my passengers seriously, so I had to be sure.
That's kind of you.
If you're having trouble, maybe talking to me would help? I might be able to cheer you up.
Wow, you're very kind. Okay, I give up.
The truth is, I'm a decoy. A guy put me up to this.
A guy?
Yeah. He has me do whatever it takes to lure taxi drivers out of their cars.
Then a bunch of heavies come and demand money.
But why do you go along with that?
My father borrowed money from someone shady, and now they're asking for a huge sum of interest.
He can't pay, so they made me do this.
If it's an illegal loan, why not complain?
I can't do that! These guys are really scary. What's a girl like me going to say to them?
I know this is a lot to ask, but could you come with me to meet these guys?
I just can't do this anymore! Maybe you could persuade them to let us off the hook?
Sure, I think I can help you out.
*pant* This guy's tough as nails. Damn it.
Ever since my parents got into debt, I've had to do this for money. But I'll stop now, I promise.
I suggest you do.
I'm really sorry. Here's my fare, and a little extra for what I put you through.
From now on I'll stick to honest, paying jobs. Thanks for getting me out of this mess.
You know, if we hadn't met this way, I'd take you on a real date anytime.
Okay. Be seeing you.
(Well, that was unexpected. At least it seems she's had a change of heart.)
Gah, this guy's tough as nails. I'll get you some other time!
(Not only did I get caught up in this mess, now I've missed out on my fare too.)
(I'll have to be more careful.)
Sorry, driver.
Where are these guys?
There they are!
So you're the leader of these blackmailers, huh? I want to talk about the money her father owes.
Well, you sure took your time!
Sorry. This driver just wouldn't take the bait.
You should have listened! I told you my job was to do whatever it took to lure taxi drivers out, right?
So this was all a trap.
Look, you're a nice guy, and I didn't really want to do this.
Aw, shut your face! This ain't the time for that. We got business to take care of.
I know, I know!
So, taxi driver. You better pay up and leave, or we're gonna bring the pain!
You're not getting a single yen from me.
Then looks like we're gonna have to pummel you until you change your mind! Get him!
Thanks, driver.
Say, can I ask you one more thing?
Could you hold my hand?
Oh, come on. What harm could it do?
Hey! What're you doing here, Miki!?
Hiroshi-kun, help! This guy's trying to drag me off with him someplace!
Get away from me, you pervert!
Hey! You've got some nerve laying your grubby hands on my girl!
(They got me. This must be one of those setups.)
What're you gonna do to make up for this, huh? You better empty your wallet if you don't want a beating!
No can do. And you can drop the act.
Say what, you old fuck!? You're a dead man now!
...A place nobody goes. Somewhere quiet.
(I guess he wants to be alone.)
(Maybe I should try to make conversation. All I can see is that mask, though.)
I notice you're wearing a mask. Do you have a cold?
Oh? Uh... Cough, cough!
I hope you feel better soon.
It's nice to hear kind words from a stranger.
(Maybe he's going through a tough time.)
That mask really suits you.
(I hope I didn't offend him.)
I notice you're covering your face. Are you wanted by the law or something?
What? Why would you think that? I haven't done anything yet!
It was just a joke.
(I guess he didn't find it funny. But what did he mean by "yet"?)
Um, driver?
How is business for you these days?
Well, I do okay.
Good for you. I just lost my company. In fact, my life has pretty much hit rock bottom.
(Things got heavy all of a sudden. How do I respond to that?)
Did you ever play on a trampoline as a kid?
A trampoline? Yes, but why?
When you jump on a trampoline, the deeper you sink, the higher you bounce back.
Yeah, so?
I think the same goes for life. You say you've hit rock bottom, but that could be a chance to bounce back higher than ever.
I think times of misfortune are good opportunities to try new endeavors.
I like the sound of that. You know, I might just have found a spark of hope.
(Looks like I've managed to cheer him up.)
Life is all about luck. Don't feel too bad. You've just got to wait until fortune finds you.
I... I guess so. Maybe catching a ride with a taxi driver who's doing well means fortune is smiling on me today.
(I don't get what he's trying to say.)
No matter how bad life gets, you can get through it if you have the willpower.
I do. Where there's a will, there's a way.
I wasn't sure I could go through with this, but you've convinced me. I'll give it a shot.
(I don't understand, but I'll play along.)
You can do it! I've got your back!
Yeah! I can totally do this!
(Hopefully that worked.)
Can I ask you to let me out here, driver?
(I wonder what he's doing way out here.)
*pant*  Looks like luck really wasn't on my side today. I ended up with a driver who's built like a tree trunk!
Or maybe I just didn't have the willpower?
A passerby reported seeing a taxi driver getting held up.
Is this the culprit? You can explain yourself down at the station. You're coming with me!
No... My life is over.
You made a mistake, but that doesn't mean your life is over.
Once you get out, work your hardest to make something of yourself. You have to keep trying.
Thanks, driver. I'll do my best.
Come on, let's hurry this up!
(I forgot to get the fare from him. But something else is bugging me.)
(I get the feeling I could have talked him out of committing that crime, if I'd been careful.)
(Driving taxis is tricky work.)
Are you sure this is where you want to get out?
Yes. The truth is, I was thinking of robbing you at first.
My company fell apart, and I've run out of savings. I thought robbery was the only option I had.
(That explains the mask.)
But after talking to you, I started to see things differently.
Don't worry. I have enough money on me to pay you. Here's the fare, and a little extra on top.
I should be the one thanking you. You talked me out of something I would have regretted for the rest of my life.
I know things must be hard for you now, but stick with it.
I will! I'll work my way up again from scratch, and someday I know I'll find happiness!
(It seems I somehow managed to turn his life around. Not a bad feeling.)
Yes. I couldn't do this if there were too many people around.
Do what?
Rob you and your taxi!
My company fell apart, and I've run out of savings. I decided robbery was my only option!
But I was never very brave, so once I got in your taxi, I didn't think I could go through with it.
After talking to you, though, I found the courage to give it a shot! Thanks, man!
(So that's what was going on. Looks like my advice came back to bite me.)
Well, hurry up! Hand over the money!
That's not going to happen. I'm sorry what I said caused you to do this, but there is another way.
I can't stop now! If you don't give me your money, I'll.... I'll have to take it by force!
(A couple, huh?)
Ah, driver! Give us a lift, will you?
(They're quiet. Maybe they had a fight? I'll try making small talk.)
Are you two on a date today?
That's right! We're heading out for some fun!
Ah. What do you have planned?
Can't tell you that. I'm taking the lady here on a surprise date!
I see. That sounds exciting.
(The woman doesn't look very happy to be here. Is she not having a good time?)
Sorry to intrude, but are you two quarreling?
Hahaha! Quarreling? Who even uses that word these days!?
I was just trying to be polite.
Haha. Quarreling. That's a classic. Funny, huh?
(It looks like her mind is elsewhere.)
You make a good couple.
The two of us? Heh, well isn't that a riot? Hahaha!
(Maybe these two aren't a couple, after all. The woman looks like she doesn't want to be here.)
Your friend is the quiet type, huh?
Yeah, she's⑬
Driver! This man, he's ab⑬
Shut it! No talking!
Hahaha. Sorry about that. She may look all docile, but once she gets started, you can't shut her up.
Wouldn't want her distracting you or anything.
(I smell trouble. Maybe this woman's caught up in something.)
(I'll turn towards the police station.)
Think you took a wrong turn, driver!
I did? Sorry about that.
Don't play dumb with me, asshole! You were trying to go to the police, weren't you!?
I'm taking this girl because she owes me money! If you want to get back in one piece, best take me where I want to go. And no funny business!
I don't owe you a thing!
You signed on as a guarantor. Same thing.
Either way, it's got nothing to do with our driver friend. Now step on it!
(She may be mixed up in something, but it's my job to follow the customer's instructions.)
Driver, please help! This man abducted me!
You little bitch!
Gah...
Come on, I'll take you back.
Hey, give me a break here! If I don't bring her back, the boss'll wring my neck!
Would you rather I wrung your neck here instead?
Yeeek! No, no!
No problem. But it did get a little dicey there.
Yeah. I should never have signed on as guarantor to my friend's loan. I'll be more prudent in the future.
Yes, please be more careful. Let's get going.
Better not squeal to anyone about this. You say a word, and she gets it!
Help me, please!
Quiet! Keep your mouth shut!
What!? You got a problem?
You haven't paid your fare.
Huh? You worried about cash at a time like this? Asshole.
Oof! Ow! You're gonna pay for that!
Think you're hot stuff, do you!? I'll beat ya to a pulp!
Thank you. Here is the fare, and a little tip as well.
No, I'm the one who should be grateful. I owe you my life! I'm so glad you were my driver tonight!
Ah, there you are! The girl I'm going on a date with should be here soon. Would you mind waiting a little longer?
No problem. So you're on a date today?
That's right! It's the first date I've ever gone on, so I'm really nervous!
Sato-san, the girl I'm going with, is incredibly cute. And she has a great personality to match.
I hope I can show her a good time... I worry I won't have anything to talk about.
Say, what's a good thing to talk about when you want to impress a girl on the first date?
Well, I think it's best to be yourself, and talk about what interests you.
I see. My interests, huh?
Well, I'm <Italic>really</Italic> into anime with cute girls! I've literally seen every series⑬even ones nobody else knows about! Whew, I could talk about them all day!
Huh? What's the matter?
I'd suggest not diving that deep on the first date.
Oh. You think so?
Some people might not understand.
Really? Then what am I supposed to talk about!?
How about something more relatable?
More relatable? I don't know if I can do that! Oh gosh, my palms are getting all sweaty. What am I going to do?
Yamada-kun! Sorry to keep you waiting!
There she is!

en: Hey, if it sounds like I'm ruining the mood, think you could help me out?
I'll do my best.
I was so surprised when you asked me out on a date, Yamada-kun.
You were?
Do you date lots of girls?
Um, er... Every day in my dreams!
What? Every day? You see that many different girls?
No, no! Don't worry, Sato-san, this is the first time I've gone out with someone in meatspace.
Huh? What's meatspace, Yamada-kun?
Uh, meatspace is just... Um... Help me out here, driver!
(I'm guessing he means "in real life," but saying that might make him sound like too much of a nerd.)
Well, meatspace is...
It's a kind of afternoon snack.
A snack? I've never heard of that one before.
Yeah, that's it! It usually involves some kind of salami!
I'd normally be chewing on one right now, but I decided to go out with you instead! Ahaha!
I'm not quite sure I understand, but I guess it's nice you picked me over food.
Hey, I'd choose you over dried meat any day, Sato-san!
Heheh! Thanks, I think. I always took you for the shy type, Yamada-kun, but you're actually pretty funny.
(Phew, she bought it.)
It's a way of complimenting people.
Yeah, that's it! Your beauty is like meat in space, a rare and wonderful thing!
Ohhh, nobody's ever said that to me before. How kind of you! Thanks, Yamada-kun!
I only say it because it's true!
I thought you were the docile, shy kind of guy, but you're actually pretty passionate and romantic. I like that!
It's a word used to describe disasters.
Yeah, that's it. I was just thinking this is turning into a complete meatspace!
